mentions.name: Air Defense Simulator
mentions.description: An air defense simulator that drops players into the operator's seat, letting them test scenarios and build air defense networks against various threat types using real-world stats, including Ukraine and Israel-Iran scenarios. A new missions feature gives the user a budget and geographical area to defend by placing different air defense assets, after which the system attacks it with various missiles and UAVs. The new version is more optimized, and the content is based strictly on open-source datasheets and datapoints.
mentions.problem: After 10 years in defense tech and watching missile attacks in Ukraine and the Middle East, the builder saw how little most people really understand about air defense.
mentions.audience: General public interested in learning about air defense; supports learning, exercises, and playing through critical-infrastructure defense scenarios.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I'm building this simulator which drops you into the operator’s seat. You can test out different scenarios and build an air defense network against various types of threats (stats from real world). Also have Ukraine, Israel-Iran scenarios. The new version is a lot more optimized, thanks in part to feedback from you all in HN. 
Currently I am working on a new featureset with missions, where the user is given a budget and geographical area to defend by placing different air defense assets; after which the system attacks it with various missiles and UAVs. Useful for just learning, exercises, playing through scenarios to defend critical infrastructure etc.

https://airdefense.dev/
